A definite must try
Jan 2026 • Solo
I had seen videos about this place and how good their stuff is and i thought id give it a try. Knowing that taste is subjective, i didn't go out of my way to find the place but while i was walking around i saw it. There was a few people in line before me so i thought 'why not' and then a longer line formed behind me while i was waiting. I was not disappointed at all. They had just taken them out of the oven and it smelled sooo good. I got two, the coffee chocolate and the vanilla. I went to sit on a bench overlooking the river and the chocolate one was honestly the best thing. the warm pastry itself was good but add the melted chocolate in the middle. It was just perfect and bigger than expected so i couldn't actually eat the vanilla one. I had it a little later when i got back to my hotel but it wasn't as good when its cold. But 100% i would recommend.
